card: `prep revise`: answer failed checks with an edit plan, not a full regenerate
guard_cases: a_revised_prep_goes_through_every_check_and_the_owner_still_approves (the approval gate does not loosen: a revised prep that still carries a link exits 6, fails urls, has no approved_by and approve_in refuses it with conflict). It was red before only because the revise API did not exist; it pins gate behaviour the change must not alter. Every pre-existing prep test (gate, approval recheck, sample checks, guide rows) also stays green unchanged.
deviations_from_card: One commit (tests + implementation): the tests cannot compile without the API (all 10 red by non-compilation before). Card's 7 acceptance cases are covered by 7 tests in prep/tests.rs, plus a guard case, a CLI-parse test and one e2e case (RPC-generated tainted prep -> revise_with -> owner approves the revision over RPC; the base still refuses). revise is CLI-only (`shadowrunr prep revise`); no `prep.revise` RPC method, so no contract edit. Store gained stage_revision()/revision() and a generic write_json (store.rs is in the write set). Approval's refusal message now says 'revise it (`prep revise`) or generate a new prep' (wording only; gate logic unchanged). Insert-slot targets are spelled `insert:connector:<kind>`, `insert:<premise|story|callback>`, `insert:cold_open.beat`; an excess count (e.g. 6 stories) yields findings on each item of that kind so a cut can answer it. A note's target is normalized to its item (`prem-03 line 1` -> `prem-03`).
notes: checks.rs: run() and findings() now share one assess() problem list (msg + targets + optional slot); run()'s prose, truncation at 8, check ids and pass details are byte-identical (the sample's stored checks test still passes). findings() runs with Dropped::default(), so items generation dropped are not targets, but the counts shortfall they caused is an insert slot. The revision prompt fences both the base material and the checker's words (they quote model text); the target list outside the fence carries only locators and check ids; owner notes are trusted and unfenced. The system prompt is the planner's persona SYSTEM (same red-line rules). Revise of a base that passes every check with no --note is exit 2 with no planner call. Gates ran in the shared checkout and were all green at the time (siblings' in-flight edits did not break compilation).
